outputs.L3:
The disclosure describes a display device that includes a display panel and a grating layer arranged in cooperation with the display panel. The display panel is configured to present image information, while the grating layer is configured to guide or modulate light emitted from the display panel so as to provide a desired viewing effect, such as directing different image information toward different viewing regions.

The display panel includes a left display area and a right display area. The left display area may be configured to display image content corresponding to a left-eye view, and the right display area may be configured to display image content corresponding to a right-eye view. Through the cooperation of the display panel and the grating layer, light from the left display area and the right display area can be directed toward corresponding left-eye and right-eye viewing zones, thereby supporting binocular or stereoscopic display.

In the left display area, the grating layer includes a plurality of left-eye grating regions corresponding to different colors. These regions include a first color left-eye grating region, a second color left-eye grating region, and a third color left-eye grating region. The grating periods of the first color left-eye grating region, the second color left-eye grating region, and the third color left-eye grating region are not uniform across the entire left display area. Instead, the grating periods gradually decrease from the center of a left-eye field-of-view central area toward a non-central area of the left-eye field of view. In this way, the grating structure may be adapted to changes in viewing angle or optical path across the left display area, improving the distribution and quality of light directed to the left eye.

Similarly, in the right display area, the grating layer includes a plurality of right-eye grating regions corresponding to different colors. These regions include a first color right-eye grating region, a second color right-eye grating region, and a third color right-eye grating region. The grating periods of the first color right-eye grating region, the second color right-eye grating region, and the third color right-eye grating region also gradually decrease from the center of a right-eye field-of-view central area toward a non-central area of the right-eye field of view. This gradual reduction in grating period allows the right display area to provide light modulation suitable for the right-eye viewing zone, helping maintain consistent display performance across central and peripheral viewing regions.

By configuring the grating periods in both the left display area and the right display area to decrease from their respective field-of-view central areas toward their non-central areas, the display device can more precisely control the propagation direction of light of different colors. This structure may reduce optical deviation, improve image clarity, and enhance the viewing experience, particularly in applications requiring separate left-eye and right-eye images.
outputs.L4:
A display device is provided that includes a display panel and a grating layer arranged on or adjacent to the display panel. The display panel includes a left-eye display area and a right-eye display area, which are configured to respectively present image information intended for a viewer’s left eye and right eye. The grating layer is used to control the propagation direction of light emitted from the display panel so that light from the left-eye display area is directed toward a left-eye viewing region and light from the right-eye display area is directed toward a right-eye viewing region.

The grating layer includes a plurality of grating regions corresponding to different color display regions of the display panel. For example, the grating layer may include first-color grating regions, second-color grating regions, and third-color grating regions, which respectively correspond to first-color, second-color, and third-color sub-pixel regions of the display panel. The first color, second color, and third color may be red, green, and blue, although other color combinations may also be used.

For each of the left-eye display area and the right-eye display area, an eye field of view may be defined. Each eye field of view includes a central field-of-view area and non-central field-of-view areas located away from the central field-of-view area. The grating regions are designed so that their grating periods vary according to their positions within the corresponding eye field of view. In particular, the grating periods of the first-color grating regions, the second-color grating regions, and the third-color grating regions gradually decrease from the center of the central field-of-view area of each eye toward the non-central field-of-view areas.

By providing color-specific grating regions with gradually varying grating periods, the display device can more accurately control the exit direction of light of different colors at different positions of the display panel. This configuration helps compensate for differences in emission position and color-dependent diffraction behavior, thereby improving the directional separation of left-eye and right-eye images. As a result, the display device can provide improved stereoscopic or directional display performance, reduce crosstalk between the left-eye and right-eye viewing regions, and enhance viewing quality across the viewer’s field of view.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a glasses-free 3D display device with left and right display areas and color-specific grating regions whose grating periods gradually decrease away from the eye field-of-view centers.
counterfactuals.output: A glasses-free three-dimensional display device is disclosed. The display device includes a display panel having a left display area and a right display area configured to respectively display left-eye and right-eye images, and an optical grating structure disposed on a light-emitting side of the display panel. The optical grating structure includes a plurality of color-specific grating regions corresponding to different color sub-pixels in the left and right display areas. Each color-specific grating region has a grating period configured according to a corresponding emission wavelength and an intended eye viewing region. In at least one of the left display area and the right display area, the grating periods of the color-specific grating regions gradually decrease in a direction away from a center of a corresponding eye field-of-view region, thereby directing light of different colors toward predetermined viewing positions and reducing color crosstalk and image interference. The device enables autostereoscopic image display with improved viewing uniformity, color consistency, and three-dimensional image quality without requiring viewing glasses.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a "present disclosure provides" paragraph describing a display panel and grating layer, where RGB left-eye and right-eye grating periods decrease from the central viewing area toward non-central areas.
counterfactuals.output: The present disclosure provides a display panel, including a display layer and a grating layer disposed on a light-emitting side of the display layer. The display layer includes a plurality of sub-pixels configured to emit light of different colors, including red sub-pixels, green sub-pixels, and blue sub-pixels. The grating layer includes a plurality of gratings respectively corresponding to left-eye viewing regions and right-eye viewing regions for the red, green, and blue sub-pixels, wherein grating periods of the gratings corresponding to RGB left-eye views and RGB right-eye views are configured to decrease from a central viewing area of the display panel toward non-central viewing areas located on at least one side of the central viewing area. By gradually reducing the grating periods away from the central viewing area, the display panel can compensate for viewing-angle variation and improve alignment of left-eye and right-eye images in peripheral viewing areas, thereby enhancing stereoscopic display quality and reducing crosstalk.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention for a display device in formal patent language: the panel has left-eye and right-eye field-of-view central areas, and the grating period for each of three colors gradually decreases outward from each center.
counterfactuals.output:
A display device is provided, comprising a display panel and a light-directing grating structure disposed in optical correspondence with the display panel. The display panel includes a left-eye field-of-view region having a left-eye field-of-view central area and a right-eye field-of-view region having a right-eye field-of-view central area. The grating structure includes a plurality of grating portions respectively corresponding to light of a first color, a second color, and a third color.

For each of the first color, the second color, and the third color, the grating portions associated with the left-eye field-of-view region have a grating period that is greatest at, or adjacent to, the left-eye field-of-view central area and gradually decreases in a direction outwardly away from the left-eye field-of-view central area. Likewise, for each of the first color, the second color, and the third color, the grating portions associated with the right-eye field-of-view region have a grating period that is greatest at, or adjacent to, the right-eye field-of-view central area and gradually decreases in a direction outwardly away from the right-eye field-of-view central area.

In some embodiments, the first color is red, the second color is green, and the third color is blue. The grating periods for the red, green, and blue grating portions may be independently configured such that, within each of the left-eye and right-eye field-of-view regions, chromatic light components are directed toward corresponding viewing zones while reducing color separation, crosstalk, or luminance non-uniformity. The gradual outward decrease of the grating period may be continuous, stepwise, piecewise linear, or defined according to a predetermined optical compensation function.

In operation, image light emitted from the display panel is diffracted or otherwise redirected by the grating structure so that left-eye image light is directed toward a left-eye viewing position and right-eye image light is directed toward a right-eye viewing position. By configuring the grating period of each color to decrease outwardly from the respective field-of-view central area, the display device provides improved angular distribution of light across the field of view, thereby enhancing stereoscopic image quality and viewing uniformity.
counterfactuals.label: cf_4

counterfactuals.prompt: Please rewrite the following concept as a patent disclosure summary: a display device includes left/right display regions and a grating layer; for both eyes, the RGB grating regions have periods that taper down from the field-of-view center to peripheral/non-FOV-center areas.
counterfactuals.output: A display device includes a display panel having a left-eye display region and a right-eye display region, and a grating layer disposed relative to the display panel. The grating layer includes grating regions corresponding to red, green, and blue sub-pixel regions for each of the left-eye display region and the right-eye display region. For both the left-eye and right-eye optical paths, the grating regions are configured such that grating periods associated with the red, green, and blue grating regions progressively decrease from a field-of-view center region toward peripheral regions away from the field-of-view center. In this manner, the grating layer provides spatially varying grating periods across the display field, with larger periods near the central field of view and smaller periods in non-central or peripheral field-of-view areas, thereby supporting optical control of image light from the respective left-eye and right-eye display regions.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
